title: Pre-extraction Sample Processing for CALIBER Project
author: James JN Kitson

steps.title: Clean Steel Beads
steps.instruction: Remove manufacturing oil from hardened carbon steel or stainless steel ball bearings.

substeps.instruction: Place beads in a borosilicate glass beaker or Duran bottle (pouring lip and lid removed).
Bake for at least 12 hours at 250 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Collection Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare 5 ml screwcap collection tubes (e.g., Starlab #E1450-1100) in batches of 96 tubes.

substeps.instruction: Add three 3 mm hardened steel beads to each tube.

steps.title: Sample Identification and Setup
steps.instruction: Retrieve and identify the plant sample.

substeps.instruction: Pick a frozen plant sample bag from the freezer and note the sample name.
Write the sample name on a manilla sample drying envelope.
Locate the corresponding dried sample label.

steps.title: Process Insect Samples
steps.instruction: Collect and preserve any insects found on the sample.

substeps.instruction: Using clean forceps, pick off all insects and place them in a screwcap tube of appropriate size (2ml, 5ml, or 15ml).
Fill the tube with a solution of 95% Ethanol and 5% Glycerol.
Label the tube with the corresponding tube label.
Store at -20 °C until transported to SASA for qPCR analysis.

steps.title: Prepare Archive Plant Sample
steps.instruction: Dry a portion of the plant material for long-term storage.

substeps.instruction: Place approximately 2-5 g of leaf and chopped stem material into the manilla envelope.
Seal the envelope with the dried sample label.
Place in an oven overnight at 35-40 °C with a tray of silica gel in the bottom.
Store the resulting archive sample at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare Extraction Sample
steps.instruction: Transfer plant material to the prepared grinding tubes.

substeps.instruction: Using a clean scalpel, slice and place ~50 mg of plant material into the pre-prepared collection tubes containing the hardened steel ball bearings.
Label the tube with the corresponding tube label.
Store at -20 °C until DNA extraction.

steps.title: Cleanup and Decontamination
steps.instruction: Dispose of waste and sterilize equipment and workspace.

substeps.instruction: Dispose of remaining plant material and packaging in a clinical waste bin.
Wash forceps and scalpel in 1x chemgene.
Rinse forceps and scalpel in molecular grade water.
Rinse forceps in 100% Isopropanol and leave to dry.
Wipe down dissection area with blue roll and 1x chemgene.
